runSummary.note: Full diversity sweep on 9.9.2026 01:12 CEST. No new unique promotion-grade item passed ranking, locality, language, skill and economic-value gates, so the 50-item LIVE feed is preserved fail-closed. Fresh Upwork public-index hits included a Worldwide WordPress plugin maintenance task posted about 1 hour before discovery, but it is expert-level and only 10 USD fixed; other fresh VA/e-commerce hits were rejected for USA-only/Spanish eligibility, excellent English plus cold calling, extreme schedule burden, low fixed-price economics or hard-development scope. Direct-company discovery found Webikon remote web development, but the role requires a modern PHP stack and is senior/hard-development. Reddit public hiring remains US-only/stale hard-dev. Facebook public index produced 0 verified hiring posts.

sources.note: Fresh public discovery reálne vykonané. WordPress Plugin Update & Maintenance Expert: Worldwide, posted ~1h, ale expert scope a 10 USD fixed = reject skill/budget. Website-sales VA vyžaduje excellent spoken/written English + denný cold calling v US hours. USA-only a Spanish-only VA hity reject eligibility/location. AI Blog Post VA 30 USD/120 článkov je už evidovaný verification low-pay hit, nie nový unique promotion.
